issues.description: Macro FIX_LEN (which determines the typedef of fix_t) is inconsistent between components in the template repository. In the template example program (example_program/src/math_fix.c) FIX_LEN is defined as 8 (fix_t -> 64-bit), while the template tests (tests/src/math_fix.h) define FIX_LEN as 4 (fix_t -> 32-bit). The solution repository uses FIX_LEN = 8 in its tests. This mismatch means the size and ABI of fix_t differ between the tests and the example program: students' assembly implementations and C code may be compiled/linked with different expected integer sizes, causing compilation errors, incorrect behavior, or silent misbehavior when tests are run. Students will be unclear which fixed-point width to implement and target.
issues.suggestedFix: Make FIX_LEN consistent across the template repository so all components use the same fixed-point width. For example, change tests/src/math_fix.h in the template repository to #define FIX_LEN 8 to match example_program and the solution, or move FIX_LEN into a single shared header included by both the tests and the example program. Also update the problem statement / README to explicitly state the required FIX_LEN (e.g. "FIX_LEN = 8 (64-bit fix_t)") so students know which width to target when implementing assembly routines.
